meta_title: A J Waller Plumbing & Heating | Derby Plumber
meta_description: A J Waller Plumbing & Heating Services in Derby. Emergency repairs, boiler installations, and heating maintenance. Same-day callouts available.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe at 2am? Our emergency team reaches Littleover and across Derby within the hour, any time.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Derby
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full system installations, we handle every plumbing and heating need.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We diagnose the problem on arrival and carry parts on the van for same-day solutions.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Upgrade
services.desc: New condensing boiler fitted with a 10-year manufacturer's warranty. We handle all paperwork and leave your heating running efficiently.

services.title: Central Heating Maintenance
services.desc: Annual servicing and repairs keep your system running safely and efficiently. Gas Safe certified, with safety certificates provided.

services.title: Radiator Installation & Balancing
services.desc: Add new radiators or balance existing ones to cut energy waste. Uneven heating? We'll have every room at the right temperature.

services.title: Bathroom Installation
services.desc: Full suite installations—taps, shower enclosures, and wet rooms. We manage plumbing, testing, and finishing to a high standard.

services.title: Powerflush & System Cleaning
services.desc: Remove sludge and debris from your heating system to improve efficiency and extend boiler life. Includes chemical treatment and testing.

about_pullquote: I started this business to give Derby families a plumber they can actually trust.
about_para_1: A J Waller Plumbing & Heating has served Derby and Littleover for 17 years. Founded on the principle that plumbing emergencies don't keep office hours, we've built a reputation for arriving fast and fixing the job right. All our engineers are Gas Safe registered and fully trained on the latest heating systems.
about_para_2: We've completed over 2,400 jobs and built lasting relationships with hundreds of Derby homeowners and landlords. Customers return because we turn up on time, explain what needs doing in plain English, and charge fairly—no surprise invoices. We stand behind every job with a guarantee.
reviews_heading: What Derby Families Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant service. Had a leaking radiator on a Saturday evening and AJ came out within 45 minutes. Fixed it straight away, very professional and didn't charge a fortune like some cowboys. Will use them again for sure.
reviews.author: Mike T.

reviews.text: Replaced our old boiler last month. The lads were tidy, explained everything clearly, and the new one's running beautifully. Great price and they handled all the paperwork. Definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Christine L.

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe and called at 11pm. They actually answered, came round first thing and sorted it before work. You don't find that kind of service anymore. Top marks.
reviews.author: David P.
